<quote by="Proposed: Miekarova, Seconded: Karov">The people of Karov wish to self-fund and build the Golden Bee Assayer's Office. This will increase tax from Karov by 2 thrones per season. ==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Duzekani, Karov, as per the '''[[Outside_the_wall#Golden_Bee_Assayers_Office|Outside the wall]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed

==Date==
* Spring 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 14 wains of mithril
* 42 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Golden_Bee_Assayer%27s_Office}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the Golden Bee Assayer's Office will have the following effects: 
* The [[Golden Bee Assayer]] will be available to appoint by Tally of the Votes of Varushkan [[mine]] and [[forest]] owners.
* Taxation from Karov will increase by two thrones
